SUMMARY: Overall imaging appearance is most consistent with a diffuse midline glioma involving the pons, extending into the left hemimidbrain, left middle cerebellar peduncle, and pontomedullary junction, with focal ring-enhancing component.
ANY_OTHER: Clinical correlation is advised. Advanced MRI techniques (DWI, perfusion, MR spectroscopy) and molecular profiling for H3 K27-altered status are recommended if tissue diagnosis is feasible.
